def transform(grid):
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x!=0).most_common(1)[0][0]
    special=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] not in (0,bg)]
    rs=[p[0] for p in special]; cs=[p[1] for p in special]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    border=Counter(p[2] for p in special).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fill=next(p[2] for p in special if p[2]!=border)
    out=[[bg]*len(grid[0]) for _ in grid]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            out[r][c]=border if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1) else fill
    return out

def transform(grid):
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x!=0).most_common(1)[0][0]
    special=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] not in (0,bg)]
    rs=[p[0] for p in special]; cs=[p[1] for p in special]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    main=Counter(p[2] for p in special).most_common(1)[0][0]
    other=next((p[2] for p in special if p[2]!=main),0)
    inner_main=any(grid[r][c]==main for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1))
    inside=main if inner_main or other==0 else other
    out=[[bg]*len(grid[0]) for _ in grid]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            out[r][c]=main if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1) else inside
    cr=(r0+r1)//2; cc=(c0+c1)//2
    out[cr][cc]=out[cr][cc+1]=out[cr+1][cc]=out[cr+1][cc+1]=other
    return out
